title: Jesus at the Feast of Booths, Living Water

questions.question: After this Jesus went about in Galilee. Why would He not go about in Judea?
options: Because the Jews were seeking to kill him
Because there was a severe famine in Judea
Because Herod warned him strictly
Because the Romans had closed the roads entirely
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Jews were seeking to kill him
questions.explanation: John 7:1 (ESV): "After this Jesus went about in Galilee. He would not go about in Judea, because the Jews were seeking to kill him."

questions.question: Which Jewish feast was at hand in chapter 7?
options: The Feast of Booths (or Tabernacles)
The Feast of Passover entirely
The Feast of Weeks completely
The Day of Atonement
questions.explanation: John 7:2 (ESV): "Now the Jews' Feast of Booths was at hand."

questions.question: Did Jesus' own brothers believe in Him at this time?
options: For not even his brothers believed in him
They proclaimed him loudly as the Messiah
They hid him from the authorities entirely
They worshipped him as Lord fully
questions.correctAnswer: For not even his brothers believed in him
questions.explanation: John 7:5 (ESV): "For not even his brothers believed in him."

questions.question: About the middle of the feast, what did Jesus do?
options: He went up into the temple and began teaching
He overturned the tables loudly
He hid securely in the garden of Gethsemane
He completely stopped healing on the Sabbath
questions.correctAnswer: He went up into the temple and began teaching
questions.explanation: John 7:14 (ESV): "About the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching."

questions.question: The officers did not arrest Him when sent by the Pharisees. Why did they say they didn't bring Him?
options: "No one ever spoke like this man!"
"He wielded the sword of David entirely!"
"The crowd shielded him safely from us!"
"He turned completely invisible securely!"
questions.correctAnswer: "No one ever spoke like this man!"
questions.explanation: John 7:46 (ESV): "The officers answered, 'No one ever spoke like this man!'"

questions.question: Why did Jesus initially say His time had not yet come to go to the feast with His brothers?
options: "The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify about it that its works are evil."
"I must fast entirely for forty days."
"The angels have not yet prepared my path securely."
"I am waiting for the Passover completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify about it that its works are evil."
questions.explanation: John 7:7 (ESV): "The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify about it that its works are evil."

questions.question: Jesus told the crowd marveling at his knowledge: "My teaching is not mine, but..."?
options: "...his who sent me."
"...the wisdom of the ancients entirely."
"...a mystery revealed exclusively to me."
"...written softly on the winds of heaven."
questions.explanation: John 7:16 (ESV): "So Jesus answered them, 'My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.'"

questions.question: When Jesus asked them "Why do you seek to kill me?", how did the crowd answer?
options: "You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?"
"We seek to kill a blasphemer completely!"
"Because the high priest commands it securely!"
"You break the Sabbath law entirely!"
questions.correctAnswer: "You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?"
questions.explanation: John 7:20 (ESV): "The crowd answered, 'You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?'"

questions.question: On the last day of the feast, Jesus cried out, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink", and what will flow out of his heart?
options: Rivers of living water
Springs of joy permanently
Blood and water entirely
Wine from the kingdom securely
questions.explanation: John 7:37-38 (ESV): "If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink. Whoever believes in me, as the Scripture has said, 'Out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus mean by "living water"?
options: He said this about the Spirit
He meant pure doctrine securely
He meant baptism carefully
He meant eternal youth entirely
questions.correctAnswer: He said this about the Spirit
questions.explanation: John 7:39 (ESV): "Now this he said about the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were to receive..."

questions.question: Jesus pointed out they circumcise a man on the Sabbath without breaking Moses' law. Why then were they angry with Him?
options: Because on the Sabbath he made a man's whole body well
Because he openly rebuked the Pharisees securely
Because he ate wheat forcefully on the Sabbath
Because he told the invalid to carry his bed lightly
questions.correctAnswer: Because on the Sabbath he made a man's whole body well
questions.explanation: John 7:23 (ESV): "If on the Sabbath a man receives circumcision, so that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because on the Sabbath I made a man's whole body well?"

questions.question: What command did Jesus give regarding judgment in John 7:24?
options: "Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment."
"Judge not, lest ye be judged entirely."
"Leave judgment to the angels completely."
"Render judgment swiftly and with a sword securely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment."
questions.explanation: John 7:24 (ESV): "Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment."

questions.question: When the Pharisees heard the crowd muttering, "When the Christ appears, will he do more signs than this man has done?", what did they and the chief priests do?
options: They sent officers to arrest him
They tore their robes openly in the street
They plotted securely to stone him immediately
They laughed off the rumors completely
questions.correctAnswer: They sent officers to arrest him
questions.explanation: John 7:32 (ESV): "The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering these things about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest him."

questions.question: Jesus said, "You will seek me and you will not find me." Where did He say He was going?
options: "Where I am you cannot come"
"To a distant island securely away"
"Into the absolute depths completely"
"To wander the earth invisibly"
questions.explanation: John 7:34 (ESV): "You will seek me and you will not find me. Where I am you cannot come."

questions.question: Which Pharisee defended Jesus, asking, "Does our law judge a man without first giving him a hearing and learning what he does?"
options: Nicodemus
Gamaliel entirely
Joseph of Arimathea exclusively
Caiaphas safely
questions.explanation: John 7:50-51 (ESV): "Nicodemus, who had gone to him before, and who was one of them, said to them, 'Does our law judge a man without first giving him a hearing and learning what he does?'"

key_verse_text: On the last day of the feast, the great day, Jesus stood up and cried out, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink."
